svg.title: Plumber — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as plumber, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A pipe wrench with two open jaws stands beside a separate right-angle pipe elbow. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face and round glasses.
